['Aldi Einkauf GmbH & Co. oHG (Nord) '].company_description: Aldi Einkauf GmbH & Co. oHG (Nord) is a German multinational discount supermarket chain. It is part of Aldi Nord, which operates over 2,200 stores in western, northern, and eastern Germany. Aldi Nord also operates internationally in countries such as Belgium, Denmark, France, Luxembourg, Poland, Portugal, and Spain. The company offers a wide range of products including groceries, household items, electronics, and more.

['Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG '].company_description: Mercedes-Benz Mobility AG is a division of Mercedes-Benz Group AG, which includes the vehicle manufacturer Mercedes-Benz AG. They are one of the largest suppliers of premium and luxury passenger cars and vans. Mercedes-Benz Mobility focuses on sustainable mobility and offers environmentally friendly charging solutions for electric vehicles, using 100% renewable electricity within their charging network.
